Produce an executable build plan for SFCC-91 in the Zimmermann PWA Kit repo at /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa.

All evidence below is already gathered and verified — do NOT re-gather it. Read files only to confirm specifics you need for concrete pass criteria (e.g. the exact shape of the renderHeader slot, the zimmProductStyleCode four-file pattern, the recipe guards).

Write nothing to the repo. Return the plan as your final message.

## Story
SFCC-91 — "PDP UI — Colour Swatches & Variation Selection". Story, High. Labels: Custom, DesignDependent, PRD-002, PRD-004, Squad-A.
Treated as a FRESH BUILD. Another developer's branch (feature/SFCC-91_pdp-ui-colour-swatches-variation-selection) and PR #70 are deliberately ignored — do not reference or reuse them.

## Acceptance criteria (from Jira, authoritative)
Swatch availability:
1. Given a product has only one colour, when the PDP loads, then the colour is displayed as a text label (e.g. "Colour: Bay Blue") and no swatches are rendered.
2. Given a product has multiple colour variations, when the PDP loads, then the index image for each colour variation is displayed as a swatch.
3. Given multiple colour swatches are displayed, when the PDP loads, then the currently viewed colour variation's swatch is visually indicated as selected.
Swatch selection:
4. Given a shopper clicks a colour swatch, when the selection is registered, then the URL updates to reflect the selected colour variation WITHOUT full page reload.
Index image not populated:
5. Given a colour variation exists but has not been enabled, when the PDP loads, then that colour variation's swatch is not rendered and the variation is not surfaced to the shopper.

## Architecture — DECIDED by Marcel, do not revisit
Per-attribute render slot on the existing product-view override. NOT a swatch-group override.

Rationale (already settled): overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx:785 loops over ALL variationAttributes — colour AND size both render through base SwatchGroup/Swatch, shape chosen at line 820 by `variant={id === 'color' ? 'circle' : 'square'}`. Overriding swatch-group would therefore change PDP colour, PDP size, PLP product tiles and every recommendations carousel (base product-tile/index.jsx:29-30 imports it, and product-tile is consumed by pages/product-list and product-scroller). The size selector additionally has its own separate Figma design (pdp/size-selector, with default/filled/active/error states, and pdp/size-selector/item with in-stock/low-stock/out-of-stock/recommended/notify-me) so it will move off swatch-group anyway.

The slot must be PER-ATTRIBUTE, not per-block — a whole-block slot would put the out-of-scope size selector into this story. Signature shape:
  renderVariationAttribute?: (attr: SfccVariationAttribute) => React.ReactNode
called once inside the existing loop, defaulting to the current inline markup so behaviour is unchanged when omitted. The PDP passes an implementation that handles `id === 'color'` and returns undefined/falls through for everything else, so size renders exactly as it does today.

Precedent to mirror exactly: commit 227171e added `renderHeader?: (props: ProductViewHeaderProps) => React.ReactNode` to this same file — type on ProductViewProps (line ~178), default at the destructure (line ~283), call sites at ~692 and ~746. Read that commit and the current file before specifying this step.

## File manifest (from a completed scope-check; verdict was RISKY, rewritten prompt closed it)
CREATE (all new):
  overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmColourSwatch/{index.tsx,index.stories.tsx,index.test.tsx,zimmColourSwatch.css.ts}
  overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmColourSwatchGroup/{index.tsx,index.stories.tsx,index.test.tsx,zimmColourSwatchGroup.css.ts}
MODIFY (exactly three, minimal edits):
  overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts — two imports + two keys, nothing else. TIER 2 (protectedFiles.md "Theme Component Styles", CODEOWNERS:117 → tier-2 + tier-1 approvers). Must be called out in the commit body.
  overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx — ONE new optional prop only. This is a 1069-line faithful copy-first port: no formatting, comment, type-tightening or unrelated changes.
  overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx — pass the slot only. CODEOWNERS:162 → pwa-squad-b (note: squadA.md:4,34 and squadB.md:41 both claim it for Squad A; CODEOWNERS is what actually requests review).
Expect .claude/registry/*.md to be rewritten by the PostToolUse hook on any overrides/app/ edit — that is not our write, but it will appear in git status.

## Hard exclusions
- Do NOT create or modify overrides/app/components/swatch-group/ (Tier 2, Squad B, four-surface blast radius).
- Do NOT touch overrides/app/components/image-gallery/ (Tier 2; PRD-062 gallery-updates-on-swatch-select is a separate story).
- Do NOT edit translations/*.json or overrides/app/static/translations/ (Tier 2, Integration/SI). Define i18n messages inline with intl.formatMessage, as zimmProductStyleCode/index.tsx does.
- Do NOT add or change anything in overrides/app/theme/foundation/ (TIER 1, absolute per AGENTS.md Hard Rule 3). If the design needs a token that does not exist, the step must STOP and ask.
- Do NOT override, wrap or modify any hook (use-derived-product, use-variation-attributes, use-variation-params). AGENTS.md Hard Rule 5. They resolve through the hooks/index.js barrel, which does not resolve in Storybook or Vitest anyway.
- Do NOT rename the SFCC attribute id "color" to Australian spelling. Australian spelling applies to Zimmermann-authored identifiers only.

## Design (Figma: Zimmermann_Design_System_2026, fileKey wPiWmZZOVKnrENUWk2XWWm)
- pdp/product-colour-picker (40000307:13823) — 6 symbols: two sizes × three states.
  Large/Rectangle 48x72: State=Unselected (40000307:13826), State=Selected (40000307:13831), State=Focus (40002689:3839)
  Small/Rounded 20x24: State=Selected (40001990:51571), State=Focus (40003447:60876), State=Unselected (40001990:51851)
- Colour Options container (40001992:51881) — Type=Large (Squared) 192x104, Type=Small (Rounded) 137x56. This node is also the ">4 colours" design.
- Placement (40000307:14062, Size=Desktop Type=Default State=Default): "Colour Options" instance sits inside "Content Card and Colour Swatch" at y=126, 218x104 — between the product description and the size selector.
- NO hover state and NO disabled state exist in the design, and both absences are correct: .docs/prd/pdp.md:17 records hover-to-preview as "a custom build, not OOTB, and not scoped for go-live", and AC 5 handles unpopulated variations by not rendering them at all.
- Base square/circle variants do NOT match: a 48x72 portrait rectangle is not a square, a 20x24 rounded rect is not a circle. The recipe needs its own variant vocabulary.

## Conventions — all mechanically enforced by `npm run test`
- Recipe keys MUST be ZimmColourSwatch / ZimmColourSwatchGroup. A key named SwatchGroup would deep-merge the base SFCC recipe and fail recipeGuards.test.ts:351 (INTENTIONAL_MERGES = ['Button','Header','ListMenu'] only).
- overrides/app/components/ui-kits/recipeParts.test.ts:101 — the recipe's declared `parts` must cover every part index.tsx reads off `styles.*`.
- recipeGuards.test.ts also enforces: no bare Chakra token key on a registered scale. Use var(--zimm-*) in the .css.ts recipe.
- var(--zimm-*) belongs in the recipe, NOT in JSX. Verified: 17 recipe files use it; exactly one component .tsx does (footer/footerNavColumn/index.tsx:44,62) and only inside a __css={{...styles.part, ...conditional}} spread the recipe cannot express.
- Apply styling via <chakra.x __css={styles.part}> — never sx or style props. textStyle set in the recipe, and it stays a bare key (no var() substitute for the composite expansion).
- Hooks above any early return (react-hooks/rules-of-hooks). Use `const intl = useIntl()`, never destructured (@typescript-eslint/unbound-method).
- Four-file pattern per component, mirroring overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmProductStyleCode/. Story title Commerce/Zimm<Name>. Vitest test scoped to the component's own contract.
- Known Vitest gap: ZimmIcon throws under Vitest (base icons barrel side effect). Mock it at the smallest surface if any component renders an icon.
- TypeScript only under overrides/. Run npx tsc --noEmit.

## Two behaviours the plan must handle explicitly
1. AC 5 ("index image not populated") is NOT the same condition as the base's `disabled={!orderable}` at line 817 — that is stock availability, this is content population. New logic either way.
2. Line 797 does `backgroundColor={name.toLowerCase()}` — using the colour's display name as a raw CSS colour keyword behind the image. "Ivory" resolves to a real CSS colour; "Bay Blue" resolves to nothing. Inherited base behaviour, marked audit-allow as verbatim. The plan must make a deliberate decision about it rather than copying it silently.

## What to return
- Goal statement.
- Scale call: multi-commit or multi-branch, with reasoning.
- File manifest with tier and owner per file.
- Ordered steps. The copy-first rule does NOT apply here (no new base-file override is being created — product-view and product-detail are already overridden), so do not invent a copy-first pause; but DO sequence so the theme registration and recipe land before the component that reads them.
- CONCRETE, checkable pass criteria per step — a command to run or an observable assertion, not "looks right".
- Per-step loop configuration for the zm-implementer/zm-tester/zm-scorer loop.
- Open questions, explicitly separated from assumptions.
- Commit breakdown, conventional-commit style. No Claude or CodeRabbit attribution anywhere in commit messages.</prompt>
</invoke>

    feat(product-view): add renderHeader slot for caller-supplied header content
    
    Adds one optional prop to ProductView so a caller can supply the header block, and
    corrects two documentation claims in the same file that were false or misleading.
    
    The slot
    ---------
    renderHeader?: (props: ProductViewHeaderProps) => React.ReactNode
    
    Its default renders the same private ProductViewHeader the base file renders inline, with
    the identical six values, so omitting it is behaviour-preserving. Both header call sites
    route through it — base renders the header twice behind responsive display arrays, and a
    slot only one of them honoured would be a silent half-override.
    
    Prop, default and call sites are one atomic unit, not three separable edits: deleting the
    default alone produces TS2722 at both call sites.
    
    Why the default export rather than a named-export wrapper
    ----------------------------------------------------------
    overrideStyling.md prescribes putting Zimmermann-only additions behind a named export that
    wraps the default. That route cannot express this requirement: a wrapper can only set props
    the default already accepts, so letting a caller replace an internal render block still
    requires the slot on the default. The only alternative is forking the component body, which
    is a graver breach of the faithful-port rule.
    
    The rule's stated purpose is served. renderHeader has zero occurrences in the base package,
    and the four base modules that import product-view — product-view-modal/index.jsx,
    product-view-modal/bundle.jsx, bonus-product-view-modal/index.jsx and
    pages/product-detail/index.jsx — neither pass it nor are affected by it. forwardRef
    behaviour is unchanged.
    
    Note overrideStyling.md cites product-tile/index.tsx (CardBaseline) and link/index.tsx as
    established precedent for the named-export split. Neither exists in overrides/, and
    CardBaseline appears nowhere in the codebase. Raised separately.

import React from 'react';
import { chakra, useStyleConfig } from '@chakra-ui/react';
import { ZimmProductName } from 'app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmProductName';
import { ZimmProductPrice } from 'app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmProductPrice';
import { ZimmProductDescription } from 'app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmProductDescription';

const ZIMM_PRODUCT_CONTENT_RECIPE = 'ZimmProductContent';

type ZimmProductContentProps = {
  /** The product's display name. */
  name: string;
  /**
   * Heading level for the name. Passed through rather than fixed here so the caller keeps
   * control of the page's heading outline — see `ZimmProductName`.
   */
  headingLevel: 'h1' | 'h2' | 'h3';
  /**
   * The price the shopper pays today, already formatted by the caller (e.g. "$450.00").
   * Optional: `ZimmProductPrice` renders nothing when absent or empty, so the flex gap
   * collapses cleanly.
   * — On sale: this is the *sale* price (the "Now" figure).
   * — Full price: this is the only price shown.
   */
  currentPrice?: string;
  /**
   * The original full price before the sale, already formatted (e.g. "$795.00").
   * Only supplied when the product is on sale (PRC-09). When present, `ZimmProductPrice`
   * switches to the Was/Now treatment — "Was {originalPrice} Now {currentPrice}".
   * Absent for full-price items.
   */
  originalPrice?: string;
  /** When true, the price atom renders an empty container while a variant re-fetch is in flight. */
  isPriceLoading?: boolean;
  /** Long description as authored in Business Manager. Omitted when the product has none. */
  description?: string;
};

/**
 * Molecule — the PDP text group: name, price, description.
 *
 * Model copy and the style code are deliberately *not* here. The design places them at the
 * bottom of the column, after the accordions, so the page positions them itself rather than
 * this molecule holding them and then having to unpick the order.
 */
export const ZimmProductContent = ({
  name,
  headingLevel,
  currentPrice,
  originalPrice,
  isPriceLoading,
  description,
}: ZimmProductContentProps) => {
  const styles = useStyleConfig(ZIMM_PRODUCT_CONTENT_RECIPE, {});

  return (
    <chakra.div __css={styles} data-testid="product-content">
      <ZimmProductName name={name} as={headingLevel} />
      <ZimmProductPrice currentPrice={currentPrice} originalPrice={originalPrice} isLoading={isPriceLoading} />
      <ZimmProductDescription description={description} />
    </chakra.div>
  );
};
